title: I Think You’re Projecting...
body: You fit an OLS model with an intercept using a design matrix X with $$n$$ rows and $$p+1$$ columns. The bias (intercept) column is the first column of X, and the remaining columns correspond to the $$p$$ features in the model. Let Y be the vector of true outcomes and $$Y_{hat}$$ be the OLS predictions. Note: $$1$$ is a vector of length $$n$$ where all elements are $$1$$. Assume X is full column rank.
